semantic_event_mapping.DRAW: native DRAW records a card moved from the hidden deck to the current player hand
semantic_event_mapping.PLAY: native PLAY records a validated card play and its visible card identity
semantic_event_mapping.DISCARD: native DISCARD records the played card entering the visible discard zone
semantic_event_mapping.PASS: native PASS ends the active player turn and switches to the other player without dealing damage
semantic_event_mapping.REVEAL: No REVEAL event is emitted: when active_player changes, the newly active player hand becomes the current visible hand; there is no separate reveal action or event.

assumptions: Two players alternate through active_player player1/player2. Each has a private hand and separate deck.
By default, both decks are copies of cards shuffled independently with deterministic seeds seed and seed+1; an explicit content.zones.deck array supplies player1 exact deck order.
opening_hand_size defaults to 3. Only the active player hand is rendered/exposed by the current-player helper; snapshots expose its count. Opponent hand and future deck orders remain hidden.
Each player starts at 3 mana by default; passing switches active player, resets the incoming player mana to 3, and changes neither health total. Passing does not draw.
Card plays retain the existing cost 1 and draw-one-after-play rule. Scout, Guard and Bolt deal 2 opponent damage; Strike deals 3; Mend heals 2 bounded by the active player maximum health.
Terminal is set when either player health reaches 0 and includes status, reason player_health_zero, and winner player ID.
There is no separate reveal mechanic or REVEAL event; hand visibility follows active_player.
Delayed action payload and future deck order are hidden from observations.
Human comparison is prepared only; no participant outcomes exist and remain unmeasured.
Source/usage and provider claims remain unverified.

visible_action_contract.source: cached from enabled DOM controls after rendering for the active player

visible_state_contract.source: cached from the last rendered DOM state attributes
